sourceQuote: B.A. Credit Management Objectives: The Credit Management specialty aims to train students with a high quality of professional knowledge to meet the need of the construction of the Socialist Market Economy and the need of many other fields concerned with securities, insurance, credit management, etc. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree
targetQuote: 信用管理学士项目目标：信用管理专业旨在培养学生具备高质量的专业知识，以满足社会主义市场经济建设的需要，以及证券、保险、信用管理等多个领域的需要。培养目标：四年制经济学学士学位
